India to Host Monsoon Session of Parliament in July

The Indian government has announced its agenda for the upcoming monsoon session of Parliament, which is scheduled to begin on July 20. The session will include five new bills, including amendments to the MSME payment-delay reforms and an income-tax measure targeting sovereign debt markets. However, some opposition parties have expressed concerns about the absence of certain bills, such as delimitation and PM-CM removal Bills, from the agenda.
